plugin.description: Shows nearby enemies with health bars, buffs, and DPS information.
settings.aura_filter_help: Match against the chip label (e.g. "Frenzy", "Empowering"). Case-insensitive substring.
settings.chip_color_seed.tooltip:
Set the seed used for randomizing buff chip background colors.
Same seed yields same color mapping each launch.
settings.chip_override_help: Add entries that match the chip's base text (without stacks or timer), e.g. "Archnemesis". The specified color overrides the random chip color. Alpha is ignored.
settings.hp_text_percent: HP Text Shows Percent (instead of absolute)
settings.only_beasts.tooltip: Wild / tamable beast monsters (Spirit Walker, Tame Beast). Matches the game's Beast monster category.
settings.require_all_auras.tooltip: Off: monster matches if it has any listed aura. On: monster must have every listed aura.
meter.title: Damage meter · observed DPS
meter.help: Estimates damage from monsters' health and shield loss. Tracks all nearby readable enemies independently of list filters. Includes all damage sources, including other players. Unlock the panel to move its title bar. Combats end after three seconds without observed damage.
meter.all_sources: Health + shield loss · all sources combined
meter.main_target_hint: Damage in the last second on the most-damaged target. An isolated single-target test requires only one enemy.
meter.multi_hint: Total damage in the last second across all targets; available when at least two enemies take damage.
meter.live_help: Single-target: one enemy hit. Multi-target: two or more within one second. The average and peak cover the whole combat; after 3 seconds without damage, the combat ends.
meter.reference_help: Finish a test, save it as a reference, change your setup, then start a new test. Available-skill changes can save the previous test automatically.
meter.no_reference: No reference saved for this combat type.
meter.different_targets: Different target counts: these tests cannot isolate a setup improvement.
meter.compare_help: Compare similar durations on the same enemies, with the same buffs and preferably solo. Damage is not attributed to an individual skill; support and passive changes are not detected automatically.
meter.detect_help: Detects additions/removals of available skills after one second of stability. Saves a previous test of at least one second as a reference and starts a new measurement. Support gems, passives, and individual damage sources are not detected.
meter.skills_changed: Available skills changed: a new measurement has started.
meter.heading: DAMAGE METER
meter.window_help: Move the window title bar to your chosen screen. Position and size are saved.
meter.window_error: The independent window could not open. The meter has returned to the game screen.
meter.trial_armed: Test ready: starts with the first observed damage.
meter.trial_interrupted: Test cancelled: target died, area changed, or reading was interrupted. Start again on an enemy that can survive 10 seconds.
meter.trial_help: For a useful comparison: play solo, use the same durable enemy, the same buffs and one skill. Run a 10-second test, save the reference, change one setting and repeat. Idle time counts. Regeneration and unreadable damage can reduce the estimate; it is not a skill's theoretical DPS.
meter.compare_steps:
1. Run a 10-second test and save the reference.
2. Change one setting.
3. Repeat on the same enemy with the same buffs.
meter.map_help: Auto-saved every 20 seconds and on area exits. Returning to the same instance resumes it. Finish the report when the map is over; it stays frozen until you choose Resume.
meter.map_measure_help: Whole-map average includes movement and idle time inside the map. Single/multi averages use periods with one/two or more damaged targets in the last second. Samples sum observed damage on the first N distinct enemies, including later hits and small damage on those same enemies. Maximum impact is the largest observed loss on one enemy between readings: several hits may be combined and overkill damage is unavailable. All sources are included.
meter.map_none: Enter a map to start a report.
meter.map_unfinished: At least one report is still open; the comparison can change.
meter.map_skills_changed: Skills changed during at least one map: it contains several setups.
meter.map_gaps: Reading was interrupted in at least one report. Its damage may be incomplete.
meter.map_compare_help: Map monsters, modifiers and density affect these values. An increase is an observed map result, not proof that a specific skill gained DPS.
meter.map_need_two: Save two different maps to compare them.
meter.map_impact_help: Largest observed health + shield loss on one target between readings. The record never decreases within the map. Several hits may be combined; damage exceeding the remaining health is not visible.
meter.map_samples_help: Cumulative observed damage on the first N distinct enemies hit in the selected mode. Later hits on those enemies add damage without counting the target twice, even for 1 damage. A value appears once N enemies are reached; otherwise progress is shown. These are damage totals, not DPS.
meter.map_samples_partial: Older reports retain their totals. Their enemy samples cover only damage observed after this feature was enabled.
